personality_one_liner: A premium, cinematic dark-mode experience using frosted glass, neon accents, and soft layers to make anonymous socialization feel exclusive and secure.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and glass panels should have clear separation.

do's: Use on Bottom Tab Bar, Sticky Headers, FAB, Featured Community Cards, and Modal Scrims.
Ensure underlying tint is >= 75% surface opacity to guarantee text readability.
Pair blur with an electric cyan subtle border (0.5pt) to define the edge.
dont's: Do not blur form fields or dense text feed regions.
Do not use glass without the underlying tint layer.
Do not make the entire screen glass.

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the premium, secure vibe and offer instant guest entry.

states.loading: Animated glowing logo pulsing with cyan aura.

screens.layout: Full bleed surface (#0F172A). Onboarding consists of 3 swipeable scenes using cyberpunk/neon abstract background imagery with a dark gradient scrim (top-down fade). Bottom 30% contains typography and a sticky CTA container wrapped in glass. 'Get Started' is the primary button, social auth is secondary/ghost.

screens.name: Anonymous Profile Creation
screens.purpose: Frictionless setup of display name and avatar without requiring email.

states.error: Validation error text below input in error color

screens.layout: Step-by-step single column. Avatar picker is a centered 2-col or 3-col grid of abstract masks in surfaceSecondary chips. Username input uses a glass/surfaceTertiary field with no borders until focused. Bottom pinned 'Continue' button over a glass bar.

screens.name: Home Feed
screens.purpose: Central hub mixing text, images, and polls from followed communities.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with subtle shimmer on surfaceSecondary
states.empty: Illustration of an empty neon city street + 'No echoes here yet.' + 'Explore Communities' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header (Logo + Search/Notif icons). Vertical ScrollView of Post Cards. Each card has a surfaceSecondary background, 24px radius, 0.5pt subtle border. Top of card: Avatar, Username, 'Community' tag in brandTertiary chip. Content: Inter text + optional full-width image (with 16px radius). Bottom row: Like/Comment/Share with Ionicons. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right: glassmorphism over brandTertiary tint with Electric Cyan '+' icon.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: Discover trending tags, posts, and localized communities.
screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top inside a glass container. Horizontal scrollable tabs (Trending, New, Popular) below search. Below tabs, a 2-column grid of Hashtag/Topic cards using surfaceSecondary, each with a subtle background glow or small neon icon.

screens.name: Communities
screens.layout: 2-column grid of large square cards. Each card uses an image backdrop (e.g., Gaming, Tech) overlaid with a heavy 80% opacity dark gradient scrim. The title and 'Join' button sit at the bottom of the card in a glass panel. Pill badge at top right indicates member count.

screens.name: Create Post
screens.purpose: Draft content with absolute privacy guarantees.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal sheet with drag handle. Top row: Cancel, 'Posting to [Community]', Post CTA. Main body is a large borderless text area. Bottom sticky row (above keyboard): Media attachment icons (Image/Poll) and an always-ON 'Anonymous' toggle switch styled with Electric Cyan.

screens.name: Anonymous Chat
screens.purpose: Secure 1-on-1 messaging without exposing real identities.
screens.layout: List view for inbox: Avatar, Nickname, snippet, unread dot (brandPrimary). Conversation view: Sticky glass header with user details. Chat bubbles: User messages are brandTertiary tint with onSurface text, Sender messages are surfaceSecondary. Text input pinned to bottom with keyboard avoiding view.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: View own anonymity score, saved posts, and achievements.
screens.layout: Top 30% is a cover banner (using abstract cyan image) with a bottom gradient fade into surface. Avatar overlaps the banner. Reputation score displayed as a glowing glass badge. Tabs for 'Recent' and 'Saved' switch the feed below. Settings icon in top right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the strict color palette using the Electric Cyan accent (#06B6D4) on Deep Navy (#0F172A).

Ensure all elevated components (Sticky headers, FABs, Modal Scrims, Tab Bars) utilize 'expo-blur' / 'expo-glass-effect' WITH an underlying tint layer of at least 75% opacity of surface or surfaceSecondary to guarantee text readability.
Implement the Anonymous onboarding as a frictionless guest-entry flow. Use the step-by-step layout defined in the screens block to prevent overwhelming users.
Use 24px (lg) border radii heavily on cards and bottom sheets to fulfill the user's explicit request for 18-24px rounded corners.
Do NOT use pure black or default grey tones. Use the assigned slate/navy hex values for surfaces.
Always apply vertical linear gradients (transparent to surfaceInverse) over background imagery before placing text to ensure WCAG AA contrast.
Implement the 'Anonymous Toggle' in Create Post prominently using the brandPrimary color.
